title: ZEROBASEONE: From Boys Planet to In Bloom
description: How ZEROBASEONE began: the 2023 show Boys Planet, their label and name, the debut EP led by In Bloom and their first wins.

questions.question: On which TV channel did Boys Planet, the 2023 show that formed ZEROBASEONE, air?
questions.fun_fact: Boys Planet ran from February 2 to April 20, 2023, and 98 contestants competed for the nine spots in the debut lineup.

questions.question: Boys Planet was presented as the sequel to which earlier Mnet survival show?
questions.fun_fact: The show used a space theme: its hosts were called Star Masters and the viewers who voted were called Star Creators.

questions.question: Who finished first in the final Boys Planet ranking in April 2023?
questions.fun_fact: His prize for first place was a solo song, Always, which closes the debut EP Youth in the Shade.

questions.question: ZEROBASEONE debuted in 2023 under which CJ ENM label?
questions.fun_fact: WakeOne began in 2014 as MMO Entertainment, a name taken from Music Makes One, the slogan of the music channel Mnet.

questions.question: The name ZEROBASEONE describes the members' journey from what to what?
options: From the base to the summit
questions.fun_fact: When the group formed in 2023, the name was explained as nine trainees starting from zero and becoming one after their debut; it is shortened to ZB1.

questions.question: Which song led ZEROBASEONE's July 2023 debut EP, Youth in the Shade?
questions.fun_fact: Youth in the Shade went on to become the first K-pop debut album to sell more than two million copies.

questions.question: In Bloom samples the main riff of which 1984 hit?
options: Girls Just Want to Have Fun
questions.fun_fact: The sampled riff comes from the Norwegian band a-ha, and Billboard later put In Bloom on its list of the 25 best K-pop songs of 2023.

questions.question: Eight days after debuting, ZEROBASEONE took their first trophy on which program?
questions.fun_fact: Less than a month later, on August 15, 2023, the group held its first fan concert at Gocheok Sky Dome for an audience of 18,000.

questions.question: Which single led ZEROBASEONE's second EP, Melting Point, in November 2023?
questions.fun_fact: The EP title draws a parallel between ice melting at 0 degrees Celsius and the group's drive to build a new world with its music.

questions.question: What was ZEROBASEONE's sweep of rookie prizes across 2023 and 2024 called?
questions.fun_fact: They took ten Rookie of the Year awards at domestic ceremonies, including the Golden Disc, MAMA, Melon and Seoul Music Awards.

title: K-pop Agency Founders
description: Who started SM, YG, Big Hit, Cube, Pledis, FNC and more? Ten questions on K-pop agencies, their founders and how they began.

questions.question: Lee Soo-man's company took the name SM Entertainment in which year?
questions.fun_fact: SM had started out as SM Studio in 1989, and under its new name it launched the boy band H.O.T. in 1996.

questions.question: Yang Hyun-suk, a former member of Seo Taiji and Boys, founded which agency?
questions.fun_fact: YG began as Hyun Planning and was later renamed Yang Goon Planning, after Yang Hyun-suk's nickname Yang Goon.

questions.question: Who founded Big Hit Entertainment, the company known today as HYBE?
questions.fun_fact: Big Hit was set up in 2005, signed the vocal trio 8Eight in 2007 and debuted BTS on June 13, 2013.

questions.question: Hong Seung-sung, a former president of JYP, co-founded which agency in 2006?
questions.fun_fact: Cube was founded as Playcube Inc., and its first two groups debuted in 2009: 4Minute in June and Beast in October.

questions.question: Pledis Entertainment, founded by Han Sung-soo in 2007, is named after what?
questions.fun_fact: Son Dam-bi was the first artist to debut under Pledis, and After School became its first girl group in 2009.

questions.question: Singer and producer Han Seong-ho founded which agency in 2006?
questions.fun_fact: FNC stands for fish and cake, and the label is home to the band N.Flying and the groups SF9 and P1Harmony.

questions.question: Lee Jung-yeop founded which agency in 2003, later the home of Infinite?
questions.fun_fact: Infinite debuted in June 2010 as Woollim's first boy group, and Lovelyz followed in November 2014 as its first girl group.

questions.question: Which rapper was the first artist Psy signed to his agency P Nation, in January 2019?
questions.fun_fact: Psy founded P Nation after leaving YG Entertainment in 2018, and in 2021 the label teamed up with JYP for the survival show Loud.

questions.question: YG producer Teddy Park co-founded which label?
questions.fun_fact: The label's first girl group, MEOVV, debuted on September 6, 2024.

questions.question: Which production duo founded High Up Entertainment, the agency of STAYC?
questions.fun_fact: High Up was set up in 2017 together with CJ E&M, and STAYC debuted on November 12, 2020 with So Bad.

title: LE SSERAFIM: The EASY to HOT Era
description: LE SSERAFIM in 2024 and 2025: the EPs Easy, Crazy and Hot, their Billboard firsts, remixes, awards and first world tour.

questions.question: When LE SSERAFIM's EP Easy entered the Billboard 200 at No. 8 in 2024, which group's EP was No. 1?
questions.fun_fact: TWICE topped the chart with With You-th, making them and LE SSERAFIM the first all-female K-pop acts in the Billboard 200 top 10 together.

questions.question: Which 2024 single gave LE SSERAFIM their first entry on the Billboard Hot 100?
questions.fun_fact: Easy also peaked at No. 3 on the Circle Digital Chart and won nine first place trophies on Korean music shows.

questions.question: Smart, the second single from the EP Easy, was described as which style of song?
questions.fun_fact: Huh Yunjin is among its co-writers, and an English version arrived on March 22, 2024 along with a set of remixes.

questions.question: Which dance style shapes the choreography of LE SSERAFIM's 2024 single Crazy?
questions.fun_fact: In the video the members dance with the House of Juicy Couture vogue team, and a remix with ballroom performer Dashaun Wesley followed.

questions.question: Which French DJ and producer released a remix of Crazy in September 2024?
questions.fun_fact: His remix came out on September 9, a few days after a version featuring the British singer PinkPantheress.

questions.question: At the 2024 MTV Video Music Awards, which prize did LE SSERAFIM win for Easy?
questions.fun_fact: At the same ceremony the group performed 1-800-Hot-N-Fun and Crazy on the pre-show.

questions.question: Which British singer joined the April 2025 remix of LE SSERAFIM's Hot?
questions.fun_fact: Hot led the group's fifth EP, released on March 14, 2025, and won first place on Music Bank, Inkigayo and Show! Music Core.

questions.question: In which city did LE SSERAFIM open the Easy Crazy Hot Tour on April 19, 2025?
questions.fun_fact: Their first world tour ran to 31 shows in Asia and North America and grossed 34.1 million dollars.

questions.question: Which BTS member is featured on LE SSERAFIM's October 2025 single Spaghetti?
questions.fun_fact: Billboard noted it was his first team-up with a K-pop girl group, and the single album came out on October 24, 2025.

questions.question: Which Japanese duo released The Noise with LE SSERAFIM in September 2025?
questions.fun_fact: The song samples the duo's 2019 single Yoru ni Kakeru and was made for the 20th anniversary of the fashion site Zozotown.

title: K-pop Songs About Magic
description: Ten K-pop songs tied to magic, spells, wishes and fairy tales, from BTS's Magic Shop to Red Velvet's Zimzalabim.

questions.question: BTS's 2018 song Magic Shop comes from which album?
questions.fun_fact: The song was inspired by Into the Magic Shop, a memoir by James R. Doty.

questions.question: TXT's 2019 single 9 and Three Quarters (Run Away) nods to a platform from which wizard story?
questions.fun_fact: It led TXT's first studio album, The Dream Chapter: Magic, and its video shows the members finding a world where they can embrace their magic.

questions.question: Which hip-swinging move from Brown Eyed Girls' 2009 hit Abracadabra became a craze?
questions.fun_fact: Its title was picked as a word meaning a conjuration, and the song spent three weeks at No. 1 on the Mnet music portal.

questions.question: Which group released Zimzalabim, a 2019 song about letting a little magic back into life?
questions.fun_fact: It led The ReVe Festival: Day 1, the first part of a trilogy, and earned the group five music show trophies.

questions.question: Girls' Generation's 2009 hit Genie has a Korean title meaning what?
questions.fun_fact: A critic noted the lyrics use a lamp, a genie and Aladdin as metaphors, and the video opens with Yoona sitting in a giant lamp.

questions.question: In IVE's 2024 video for Accendio, the members try to protect what object?
questions.fun_fact: They are told to guard it until midnight to gain special powers, then fight dark versions of themselves for it.

questions.question: Which rock band's 2015 single Cinderella was a modern take on the European folktale?
questions.fun_fact: Vocalist Jung Yong-hwa wrote and composed it, and the song went on to earn five music show wins.

questions.question: IU's 2013 hit The Red Shoes was inspired by a fairy tale written by whom?
questions.fun_fact: It led her album Modern Times, and the plot of its music video was adapted from the 1948 British film The Red Shoes.

questions.question: Gugudan debuted in 2016 with Wonderland, from an EP named after which fairy tale?
questions.fun_fact: The debut EP, Act. 1 The Little Mermaid, came out on June 28, 2016, and the group followed it with Act. 2 Narcissus in 2017.

questions.question: ITZY's 2022 single Cheshire borrows the concept of a famous cat from which story?
questions.fun_fact: The song came out with its EP on November 30, 2022. Ryujin said the cat helped the group express an ambiguous feeling, and the video plays out like a game show.

title: TREASURE True or False
description: True or false? Test what you know about TREASURE, from YG Treasure Box and Boy to their Japanese releases and tours.

questions.question: 29 trainees competed on YG Treasure Box, the program that led to TREASURE.
questions.fun_fact: The final seven were introduced as TREASURE, a second unit called Magnum followed, and the two were later merged under one name.

questions.question: The First Step series ended with TREASURE's first EP in January 2021.
questions.fun_fact: It ended with their first studio album, The First Step: Treasure Effect, and the series sold one million copies in five months.

questions.question: The music video for Boy became TREASURE's first to pass 100 million views on YouTube.
questions.fun_fact: The video for the debut single passed 10 million views within 26 hours of its release in August 2020.

questions.question: Orange, TREASURE's first self-produced song, was composed by Jihoon.
questions.fun_fact: Asahi composed it with Future Bounce, his first credit as a composer, and it appeared on The First Step: Chapter Three in 2020.

questions.question: Beautiful, TREASURE's first original Japanese song, was made for the anime Black Clover.
questions.fun_fact: It served as the anime's 13th ending theme and led the Japanese version of their debut studio album.

questions.question: TREASURE won their first music show trophy with Boy in 2020.
questions.fun_fact: Their first trophy came in 2022 on Show Champion with Jikjin, the lead single of their first EP, The Second Step: Chapter One.

questions.question: TREASURE's first concert tour of Japan, which began in November 2022, drew about 300,000 fans.
questions.fun_fact: The tour was later extended into the Hello tour across Asia, with an estimated 420,000 people in total.

questions.question: TREASURE's 2023 fan meeting tour of Japan ended with a show at Tokyo Dome on November 12.
questions.fun_fact: The fan meeting tour opened in Fukuoka on September 2, 2023 and visited five Japanese cities before its Tokyo Dome finale.

questions.question: King Kong was the lead single of TREASURE's 2023 album Reboot.
questions.fun_fact: Reboot was led by Bona Bona, with the T5 single Move as a pre-release; King Kong came out as a digital single on May 28, 2024.

questions.question: TREASURE had nine members when they debuted in 2020.
questions.fun_fact: They debuted with twelve members. Mashiho and Bang Ye-dam left in November 2022, and TREASURE continued as ten.
